one_line: Snowflake reference for the DROP MODEL command, which removes a machine learning model from a schema, with name parameter rules.
key_facts: The DROP MODEL command removes a machine learning model from the current or specified schema in Snowflake.
DROP MODEL is available to all Snowflake accounts.
The syntax for the command is: DROP MODEL <name>
The name parameter specifies the identifier for the model to drop.
If a model identifier contains spaces or special characters, the entire string must be enclosed in double quotes.
Identifiers enclosed in double quotes are case-sensitive.
A fully-qualified model name takes the form db_name.schema_name.model_name.
A partially qualified model name takes the form schema_name.model_name.
If the model identifier is not fully-qualified, the command looks for the model in the current schema for the session.
